messages:
Anaya (AE): Hey team — attached the customer's RFP appendix. They want a compact capability matrix + short SOW snippet for a 4-week POC. Can we draft today?
Sam (SE): Skimming now. Key asks: on-prem HSM, dedicated throughput SLA, and embedding latency under 50ms for batch sizes of 16.
Liam (ML Eng): Embedding 50ms depends on model/quant. We'll need to call out recommended model variants + quantization. Propose column: "Embedding perf (50ms@B16)" with Pass/Recommend rows.
Priya (Solutions): Good idea. Also add a column for "Routing/Fallback policy" — they care about graceful degradation to smaller models.
Tess (Legal): They also attached a security questionnaire. I'll need the KMS/HSM answers and data residency text. Ping me the current HSM paragraph.
Sam (SE): I'm updating the matrix now. Quick question on pricing — do we give a fixed POC rate or banded? They asked for rate per 1M tokens and embeddings units.
Anaya (AE): They prefer a fixed POC cap for procurement simplicity. Suggest we propose a capped POC invoice: $12k for 4 weeks (includes up to X reserved hours + limited dedicated capacity). But include optional add-ons for longer retention.
Liam (ML Eng): For the matrix, I'll add a "Quantized model support" column and a short note about expected delta in latency/cost. Example note: `int8 quant -> ~1.7x throughput, ~20% quality regression on long-context`.
Priya (Solutions): I'm assembling the SOW snippet. Draft bullets: objectives, success criteria (90th pct latency <120ms for gen OR embeddings 50ms@B16), deliverables (dedicated pool, gen+embed eval harness, weekly checkpoints), owners.
Sam (SE): Posting working files here: cap_matrix_v1.csv and poc_sow_snippet.md (uploads done). rfi-bot: uploaded cap_matrix_v1.csv (12kb)
rfi-bot: uploaded poc_sow_snippet.md (3kb)
Tess (Legal): Quick review note — for HSM we must avoid writing that we manage keys. Use: "customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integration; Redwood supports BYOK and HSM-backed CMKs." I'll paste exact line in the questionnaire.
Anaya (AE): Can someone add a single-row pricing table we can drop into their procurement? Something like: Hosted API tokens: $X / 1M tokens; Embeddings: $Y / 1M units; POC cap: $12k. Keep ranges so procurement has flexibility.
Sam (SE): Draft pricing table added to poc_sow_snippet.md: "Hosted Gen: $4.50 / 1M tokens (volume tiers), Embeddings: $25 / 1M units, Dedicated POC (4w): $12,000 flat — includes 100 reserved GPU hours." Pls sanity-check.
Liam (ML Eng): Sanity-check: $25/1M embeddings looks high for batch workloads; recommend offered discount for embed-heavy workloads in SOW: tiered down to $8 / 1M at >50M units. I'll add note.
Priya (Solutions): I'm also adding a small acceptance test list to SOW: 1) perf baseline script + dataset (we'll run 3 runs), 2) functional correctness on 500 prompt/response pairs, 3) embedding recall test on 200 queries.
Tess (Legal): For the questionnaire Q12 (key rotation/audit): use: "Redwood supports customer-managed rotation policies via KMS, provides audit logs for key usage, and can integrate with customer SIEM via syslog/forwarding." Fine?
Sam (SE): Good. One more blocker: customer wants a clear rollback plan if canary fails. We should add a line under operations: "automated fallback to compatible model variant + region failover; manual canary rollback steps included."
Anaya (AE): Nice. Action items: Sam finalize matrix + pricing by EOD; Priya finalize SOW + acceptance criteria; Tess to drop Q12/Q7 answers in questionnaire; Liam to add perf caveats and model recommendations. I'll consolidate and send to customer tomorrow AM.
Liam (ML Eng): Quick code snippet I recommend including in the SOW for their ops runbook (keeps it short):
```
# example: agented fallback policy
route = policy(primary_model='redwood-4b-quant', fallbacks=['redwood-4b-fp16','redwood-2b'])
if latency>target: route.scale_down(fallback='redwood-2b')
```
Priya (Solutions): LGTM. I'll also attach a CSV with the feature mapping to the procurement doc so they can import it.
Sam (SE): Uploaded cap_matrix_final.csv and poc_pricing_table.png. rfi-bot: uploaded cap_matrix_final.csv (14kb)
rfi-bot: uploaded poc_pricing_table.png (6kb)
Tess (Legal): I'll run a quick sweep and send final security Q answers by 4pm.
Anaya (AE): Thanks all — please add any last comments here. If nothing, I'll bundle and send at 09:00 AM PST tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Sam (SE): no further comments from me. :thumbsup:
Liam (ML Eng): all good. I'll push a small note in the matrix about known edge-case: multi-tenant KV cache pre-warm cost.
Priya (Solutions): Sending final SOW draft in 45m.
Tess (Legal): Done for Q12 & Q7. Pasted into questionnaire doc.
Anaya (AE): Perfect. Closing thread after send.
